title: MiniMax H3 Semantic Bridge adds an adapter for H3's FL2VA text path
summary: MiniMax H3 Semantic Bridge provides a ComfyUI conditioning adapter for MiniMax H3's standard FL2VA text-conditioned workflow. It is a community project, not an official MiniMax or SenseNova release; Ref2VA support was not released after the author's tests degraded singing and lip-sync.
research_notes:
Install the released custom-node archive under ComfyUI/custom_nodes/, place MiniMaxH3_SemanticBridge_v1.safetensors under ComfyUI/models/semantic_bridge/, restart ComfyUI, and start from the supplied workflow reference.

Use v1 only with the standard MiniMax H3 FL2VA/text-conditioned route. Do not put it into Ref2VA or another reference-conditioned workflow.

Begin at alpha 0.10 with per-token magnitude matching. Compare native H3 and bridge-enabled output using the same prompt, seed, and generation settings; treat the published alpha 0.15 comparisons as examples rather than a universal preset.

Keep the author's representation-space cosine measurements separate from video-quality claims. The release says they measure agreement with a teacher-derived representation, not perceptual quality or universal prompt-adherence improvement.
